def transform(grid):
    # The frame encloses a rectangular field; the marked cell is the center
    # of concentric square bands, clipped to the field.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pts = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == 3]
    # retain outer frame, identify interior bounds from the horizontal frame lines
    rows = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 3 for v in row if v == 3) and sum(v == 3 for v in row) > 2]
    top, bottom = min(rows), max(rows)
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[top][c] == 3]
    left, right = min(cols), max(cols)
    marker = [(r,c) for r,c in pts if top < r < bottom and left < c < right]
    mr,mc = marker[0]
    for r in range(top+1,bottom):
        for c in range(left+1,right):
            d = max(abs(r-mr), abs(c-mc))
            out[r][c] = 4 if d % 2 == 1 else 2
    out[mr][mc] = 3
    return out
PY
